review_candidates.description_excerpt: Job Description We are looking for an experienced NOC Infrastructure Administrator to join our team remotely. The NOC Infrastructure Administrator is responsible for monitoring, administration, and operational support of Linux, Windows, and cloud-based infrastructure in a 24/7 production environment. This role focuses on maintaining system availability, resolving technical issues, supporting operational processes, and ensuring the stability and performance of critical business systems. The ideal
eligibility_evidence: Competitive pay and benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate has strong system administration experience, solid troubleshooting skills, and hands-on knowledge of cloud platforms, virtualization technologies, networking fundamentals, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
